HowItWorks.description: From your first inquiry to ongoing service — a clear process with no pressure and no surprises.

office: Complete disinfection of high-touch surfaces (doorknobs, switches, keyboards)

medical: Clinical grade disinfection compliant with healthcare standards
Cross-contamination prevention using color-coded microfiber tools
Hazardous dust extraction and cleanroom protocols
Sterilization of patient waiting rooms and exam chambers
Bio-safe disposal management and compliance documentation
retail: High-traffic entrance glass polishing and detailing
Luxury marble/hardwood floor buffing and high-gloss waxing
Display case dust elimination and fingerprint removal
Fitting room sanitation and mirror conditioning
Spot treatment of textiles, rugs, and seating areas
industrial: Heavy-duty dust and drywall residue vacuuming
Subfloor scraping and concrete sealer preparation
Industrial grease, paint splatters, and adhesive extraction
High-ceiling pipe, duct, and light fixture vacuuming
Final white-glove inspect-ready detail for tenant handoff
